text: dsh-claude-skin（DSH Web 插件）：为 DSH Web 界面换上 Claude 风格的暖黑与暖白主题，并用陶橙色强调交互元素。它通过浏览器端样式覆盖和主题 token 调整界面外观，随 DSH 原生亮暗主题切换；插件页还提供 Anthropic 原生、皮肤衬线和系统默认三种字体模式，可按需安装对应字体。适合希望自定义 DSH Web 视觉风格和阅读字体的用户。字体模式保存在浏览器本地，不需要 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-claude-skin gives DSH Web a Claude-inspired warm dark and light theme with clay accents. It follows the native theme and offers three font modes on its plugin page: Anthropic, skin serif, and system default. The preference stays in browser storage; no API key or account is needed.

dsh-claude-skin 的功能「切换字体模式」：在插件页的配置项中选择 Anthropic 原生、皮肤衬线或系统默认字体；选择会即时应用并保存在浏览器 localStorage。

dsh-claude-skin README · 中文正文：思源宋体（SemiBold 字重）：字重由两条 `@font-face` 控制：`Dsh CJK Serif` 用 `local()` 引用系统里已安装的思源宋体切面，并用 `unicode-range` 只覆盖汉字区段 —— 字重 < 600 走 **SemiBold** 切面，≥ 600 走 **Bold** 切面。这样正文汉字是真正的 SemiBold，标题不必再靠浏览器合成粗体，西文部分也完全不受影响；没装字体时 `local()` 失配，字族继续回退到 `Source Han Serif SC` / `思源宋体` / 系统宋体。

新对话空态的两处文字原本到不了衬线字族：「探索未至之境」大标题继承的是 UI 无衬线字族，「预览版」徽章则被应用钉在等宽字族。皮肤用一条规则把两者指回 `--dsw-font-serif`，因此 anthropic / skin 模式下它们与正文一样是思源宋体；「系统默认」模式则保持不干预字体。这两处按 `font-weight: 700` 取思源宋体的 **Bold** 切面，是真实字重而非合成加粗。

dsh-claude-skin README · Chinese body text: 思源宋体 (SemiBold)：The conversation serif stack is ordered like this:

```css
--dsw-font-serif:
  "Anthropic Serif Web Text", Georgia, "Times New Roman",
  "Dsh CJK Serif",              /* ← han glyphs only: SemiBold / Bold cuts */
  "Source Han Serif SC", "思源宋体", "Noto Serif SC", "Songti SC", serif;

Anthropic Serif has no Han glyphs, so **Latin uses Anthropic Serif and Chinese uses 思源宋体** — the browser falls back per glyph, no markup changes needed. The `skin` (serif UI) mode resolves to 思源宋体 as well.

text: dsh-claude-skin README · Chinese body text: 思源宋体 (SemiBold)：Weight is handled by two `@font-face` rules: `Dsh CJK Serif` references the installed 思源宋体 cuts through `local()` and restricts itself with `unicode-range` to the Han ranges — weight < 600 resolves to the **SemiBold** cut, >= 600 to the **Bold** cut. Chinese body copy therefore gets a real SemiBold, headings no longer need a synthesised bold, and the Latin half of a run is untouched. When the font is missing the `local()` lookup fails and the stack falls through to `Source Han Serif SC` / `思源宋体` / the system Song faces.

text: dsh-claude-skin README · Chinese body text: 思源宋体 (SemiBold)：Two pieces of the new-session hero would otherwise miss the serif stack: the headline inherits the UI sans stack, and the preview badge is pinned to the mono stack by the app. The skin routes both back to `--dsw-font-serif`, so they turn up in 思源宋体 under the anthropic and skin modes; the system font mode still leaves the native fonts untouched. Both are set to `font-weight: 700`, which resolves to the real **Bold** cut.

dsh-claude-skin README · Compatibility：How it was audited: the client slot contract (`plugins.bundle.config` keyed registration, `view: 'page'`, ledger lookup by npm package name), the module table (`react`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), the `dsh.client.platform === 'web'` manifest check, the handwritten `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})` bundle format, the `data-ds-dark-theme` / `data-slot` / `data-plugin-config` DOM anchors and every class name the skin targets, plus the theme tokens: rc.5's five client packages (theme / slots / plugin-manager / primitives / store) are byte-identical to rc.4 apart from the version field. The one client-side contract change in rc.5 is `conversation.chat.reasoning.body` gaining `rawText` while `text` becomes the display-processed string; this skin does not register that slot and writes no reasoning styles, so nothing had to change. alpha.2 only drops the unused `--dsw-specific-sidebar-nav-item-hover` and adds the `--dsw-alias-illustration-*` family (remapped to warm neutrals here). 0.2.2-rc.1 is a host-side release: `ui-slots`' `lib/` is byte-identical to rc.5, `plugins.bu

dsh-claude-skin README · Switching fonts：Open the sidebar's **Plugins** panel → Installed plugins → **Claude Flavour Theme**, then find **Font style** in its configuration section:

- **Anthropic native (default)**: Sans UI / Serif body (思源宋体 SemiBold for Chinese) / Mono code
- **Skin serif**: Georgia-style serif UI, 思源宋体 SemiBold for Chinese
- **System default**: keep DSH's default fonts

The selection applies instantly and is saved in browser localStorage. Settings → General no longer shows this row.
dsh-claude-skin README · Switching fonts：> If you previously installed `dsh-anthropic-fonts` separately, remove it first to avoid two font overrides fighting each other.

dsh-claude-skin README · Switching skins：Only one skin is active at a time. This fork uses its own loader row id **`ui-claude-skin`** (upstream uses `ui-skin-claude`) and its own skin id `claude-skin`, so the two packages never collide at the loader level. They do share the `data-dsh-claude` body scope and each injects its own `<style>`, so **do not enable both** — the later one wins.

Edit `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml

dsh-claude-skin README · outside the dsh-skin managed section：- insert:
    - id: ui-claude-skin
      name: 'dsh-claude-skin'
```

(and add `disabled: true` to the currently active skin's row). The config watcher hot-reloads within seconds; refresh the page.

dsh-claude-skin README · Uninstall：1. Remove the `ui-claude-skin` insert row from `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`.
2. `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-claude-skin`
3. Restart `dsh web`.
